annotation.evidence_span: MUST NOT send new flow-controlled frames until it receives WINDOW_UPDATE frames that cause the flow-control window to become positive.
annotation.interpretation_a: The sender must wait until the window is strictly greater than zero before sending frames.
annotation.interpretation_b: The sender can send frames when the window is zero or positive.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'become positive' is ambiguous. Does it include zero? If so, the sender can send frames when the window is zero. If not, the sender must wait until the window is strictly greater than zero.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether a flow-control window of zero is considered 'positive' for the purpose of allowing frame transmission. This affects implementation of the conditional check.
